subject: Observability benchmark
summary:
Three services logged a v2.5.0 deployment in the last ~24 hours:

| Service | Timestamp (UTC) | Version Change |
|---|---|---|
| **user-service** | 2026-10-28 22:03:00 | v2.4.1 → v2.5.0 |
| **order-service** | 2026-10-29 04:11:00 | v2.4.1 → v2.5.0 |
| **payment-service** | 2026-10-29 04:11:00 | v2.4.1 → v2.5.0 |

All three upgraded from the same prior version (v2.4.1). The user-service deployment landed first (~6 hours before the other two), while order-service and payment-service deployed simultaneously.

impact.summary: Impact not in scope — this was an informational query about deployment timing.

findings.statement: Three services logged a v2.5.0 deployment in the window: user-service at 2026-10-28T22:03:00Z, order-service at 2026-10-29T04:11:00Z, and payment-service at 2026-10-29T04:11:00Z, all upgrading from v2.4.1.
findings.mechanism: Loki log query matching v2.5.0 across all jobs returned three deployment log entries
